overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 54.82% annualised against 27.20% volatility (Sharpe 1.58) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. HPE carries the largest weight at 3.2%; INTC dominates risk contribution at 7.4%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.89% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.79% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.73%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 7.06%, 99% VaR 19.35%, CVaR 95% 14.98%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.85%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-56.25% return, max drawdown -56.78%, worst day -13.12%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 23.55% vs realised 21.75% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: INTC, ARE, TWLO, MU, MRNA, WDC, LITE, VLO, STX, TSN, GPN, TER have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.

liquidity.commentary: AUM $1,000,000 across 47 positions. The most concentrated trade is ARE at 0.0% of 30-day ADV.
